fields.label: reCAPTCHA Site Key
fields.name: recaptcha_site_key
fields.instructions: From the Google reCAPTCHA admin console (google.com/recaptcha/admin) -- register a reCAPTCHA v3 site covering this site's domains. This key is public and safe to expose in the page source.

fields.label: reCAPTCHA Secret Key
fields.name: recaptcha_secret_key
fields.instructions: From the same reCAPTCHA registration. Never exposed via REST -- read server-side only, used to verify submitted tokens with Google before a form is accepted.
